title: Machine relay
text: Relay health keeps server-settled quarantine records and their count as evidence without degrading health. Active report failures remain retrying; unsettled codes, missing codes, or an incomplete retained list remain quarantined. Refused takes precedence. No quarantine payloads are deleted or replayed. A missing Cursor CLI is unsupported with cli_unavailable and no models, so probe-models succeeds without a relay failure; an installed CLI whose listing fails remains a failure.
